channel.title: mycatalog updates
channel.description: 'My Catalog' uses the IBM Cloud catalog API to retrieve data from the catalog. It attempts to be as accurate as possible. This feed shows additions, updates, removals from the catalog. Use with care. It is a work-in-progress :)

item.title: [updated] OpenPages (openpages) has removed the plan named saastrial
[updated] Quantum Compute (quantum-computing) has changed the description of the plan named open
item.description: *before*: Provides ten minutes free runtime per month on select IBM quantum computers. After the limit is met, workloads will be blocked and no additional charges will occur., *after*: Provides resource units enabling up to 10 minutes of free runtime per month on select IBM quantum computers. After the limit is met, workloads will be blocked and no charges will occur.

item.title: [updated] Quantum Compute (quantum-computing) has changed the description of the plan named paygo-standard
item.description: *before*: Pay for the IBM quantum computer access you use. Billed per second of usage., *after*: Pay for the IBM quantum computer access you use. Billed per resource unit consumed.
